resize.mechanism: pywinpty ConPTY PtyProcess.setwinsize (ResizePseudoConsole); child observes via os.get_terminal_size(fd=1) and prints a SIZE line on change

ctrl_c.mechanism: pywinpty write '\x03' -> console control event -> child KeyboardInterrupt (observable marker + exit code 130); both pywinpty backends are probed and recorded, the delivering one carries the verdict

backend_observations.note: no interrupt marker within the observation window

encoding.mechanism: ConPTY UTF-8 input/output round trip via pywinpty PtyProcess write/read

process_tree_exit.mechanism: win32 Job Object (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_CLOSE, ctypes direct -- r0 form) assigned to the ConPTY child BEFORE the PTY-input proceed gate releases the grandchild; TerminateJobObject must cover the pseudoconsole child AND the grandchild
process_tree_exit.tree_shape: probe -> PTY child (explicit interpreter) -> grandchild (explicit interpreter, PTY-input proceed gate)

notes: sanitization: host paths <WORKSPACE>/<TEMP> placeholders only; no usernames, PIDs, prompts, secrets or endpoints recorded
restricted = capability untestable in this environment with a recorded reason, not a pass; failed = primitive not validated on this platform (platform not enabled per PHASE2-MODULES L68)
the POSIX leg is carried by CI dual-OS; the dispatcher closes that record (manual and ci_verified never impersonate each other)
